title: 钽矿采购对账：争议余额、独立化验与受控放行
english: Tantalum procurement reconciliation and controlled release

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 慢读三遍再正常语速读三遍
lines: Provisional settlement
暂定结算
Independent assay
独立化验
Disputed balance
争议余额
Document reconciliation
单证对账
Conditional release
有条件放行

modules.title: 10个高频词组
modules.hint: 每个词组造一个完整英文句子
lines: Provisional invoice
暂定发票
Final settlement
最终结算
Retention amount
暂扣金额
Joint sampling
联合取样
Sealed reference sample
封存留样
Contractual tolerance
合同容差
Verified beneficiary
已核验收款人
Weighbridge record
地磅记录
Release instruction
放行指令
Audit trail
审计追踪记录

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 按采购、财务、物流角色朗读并替换主语
lines: We can settle the undisputed portion today.
我们今天可以结算无争议部分。
The disputed grade requires independent verification.
争议品位需要独立核验。
Please preserve the original assay certificates.
请保存原始化验报告。
We need a jointly signed sampling record.
我们需要双方签字的取样记录。
The final price depends on the verified dry weight.
最终价格取决于核实后的干重。
Please identify the relevant contract clause.
请指出相关合同条款。
We cannot change the laboratory result without evidence.
没有证据我们不能修改实验室结果。
The beneficiary must pass independent verification.
收款人必须通过独立核验。
Do not release the truck without written authorization.
未经书面授权不得放行车辆。
We will send a documented decision by the agreed deadline.
我们将在约定期限前发送书面决定。

modules.title: 金额吨位品位汇率口述
modules.hint: 全部数字仅供模拟，口述并解释百分点
lines: The fictional gross weight is eight point four tonnes.
虚构毛重为8.4吨。
The assumed moisture is three percent.
假设含水率为3%。
The calculated dry weight is eight point one four eight tonnes.
计算干重为8.148吨。
The supplier reports a grade of thirty-two percent.
供应商报告品位32%。
Our laboratory reports thirty point eight percent.
我方实验室报告30.8%。
The difference is one point two percentage points.
差异为1.2个百分点。
The illustrative price is four dollars per MKU.
示例价格为每MKU四美元。
The assumed exchange rate is one dollar to fifteen hundred francs.
假设汇率为一美元兑1500法郎。
A fictional retention of five thousand dollars equals seven point five million francs.
虚构暂扣5000美元相当于750万法郎。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 每句跟读五遍，最后脱稿复述
lines: We received two different assay results for the same sealed mineral lot.
同一封存矿产品批次收到两份不同的化验结果。
We are checking the sampling method and moisture records before confirming the settlement grade.
确认结算品位前我们正在核对取样方法及水分记录。
We can discuss an interim payment, but the disputed amount will remain on hold until verification is complete.
我们可以讨论临时付款，但核验完成前争议金额继续暂缓。
Our goal is to protect the business relationship without weakening compliance controls.
我们的目标是在不削弱合规控制的前提下维护商业关系。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 两人互换角色进行自然对话
lines: Thank you for joining the reconciliation meeting.
感谢参加对账会议。
Was the journey from the warehouse smooth?
从仓库过来一路顺利吗？
Yes, everyone arrived safely.
是的，大家都安全抵达。
Shall we compare the documents before discussing the figures?
讨论数字前先核对文件好吗？
That sounds reasonable. Let us begin.
很合理，我们开始吧。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 压力一供应商催款；压力二经理要求改化验，逐轮示范
lines: Supplier: Pay the full amount today or we will stop deliveries.
供应商：今天全额付款，否则我们停止供货。
Buyer: We value the partnership, but the disputed balance requires verification.
采购方：我们重视合作，但争议余额需要核验。
Supplier: Your laboratory must change its result immediately.
供应商：你们实验室必须立即修改结果。
Buyer: We cannot instruct a laboratory to alter a result without technical evidence.
采购方：没有技术证据，我们不能指示实验室更改结果。
Buyer: Let us jointly inspect the sealed sample and appoint an independent laboratory.
采购方：让我们联合检查封样并指定独立实验室。
Supplier: Who pays for the additional testing?
供应商：额外检测费用由谁承担？
Buyer: We will follow the contract or agree on the cost allocation in writing.
采购方：我们将遵循合同或书面约定费用分摊。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 压力三代理要求先放货后补文件，练习拒绝
lines: Driver: The truck has been waiting for six hours.
司机：车辆已等候六小时。
Logistics: Please remain in the authorized secure parking area.
物流：请继续在指定安全停车区等候。
Agent: We can submit the missing certificate after crossing the border.
代理：我们可以过境后补交缺失证明。
Compliance: We cannot release cargo without mandatory documents.
合规：缺少必需文件我们不能放货。
Escort: I will record the seal number and custody handover.
押运员：我会记录封签号及交接情况。
Compliance: Never backdate a certificate or alter an original record.
合规：绝不能倒签证明或篡改原始记录。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 三轮各五分钟：先回应，再说明证据和下一步
lines: Round one: The supplier threatens to cancel future deliveries unless the disputed balance is paid.
第一轮：供应商威胁若不支付争议款就取消后续供货。
Model: We can review a documented interim settlement, but cannot release unverified funds.
示范：我们可以审查有书面依据的临时结算，但不能支付未经核验的款项。
Round two: A manager demands acceptance of the higher assay without resampling.
第二轮：经理要求不复检就接受较高品位。
Model: I can escalate the urgency, but the grade must follow the agreed dispute procedure.
示范：我可以上报紧迫性，但品位必须按约定争议程序确定。
Round three: The agent proposes backdating a missing certificate.
第三轮：代理建议倒签缺失证明。
Model: We cannot backdate documents; please arrange secure parking and a revised schedule.
示范：我们不能倒签文件；请安排安全停车和修订时间表。
Challenge: Explain all three decisions to the buyer in sixty seconds.
挑战：用六十秒向买方解释全部三项决定。
Model: The goods are secure, disputed funds are held, and we will update you after independent verification.
示范：货物安全保管、争议款暂缓，独立核验后我们会更新进展。

modules.title: 5句听写
lines: The disputed balance remains on hold.
争议余额继续暂缓。
We need the signed sampling record.
我们需要已签署的取样记录。
Please verify the beneficiary independently.
请独立核验收款人。
The truck cannot leave without authorization.
没有授权车辆不能离场。
We will issue a written reconciliation statement.
我们将出具书面对账说明。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 每题三十秒，回答结论、理由、行动
lines: How would you respond to a demand for immediate disputed payment?
如何回应立即支付争议款的要求？
What is the difference between percent and percentage points?
百分比与百分点有什么区别？
Which records should be checked before revising an invoice?
修改发票前应核对哪些记录？
How would you refuse a request to backdate a customs certificate?
如何拒绝倒签海关证明？
How would you explain a shipment delay professionally?
如何专业解释发运延误？

modules.title: 前三课及近期知识复习
modules.hint: 回顾近三课核心知识并连接今日情景
lines: We previously checked moisture deductions before settlement.
此前我们在结算前核查水分扣减。
We reconciled batch identifiers across export documents.
我们核对了出口文件的批次编号。
We verified beneficiary details before releasing payments.
我们在付款前核验收款人资料。
Today we combine assay reconciliation with controlled release.
今天我们将化验对账与受控放行结合。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 逐句朗读两遍，再脱稿向管理层汇报
lines: Good morning. I will brief you on a disputed mineral procurement lot.
早上好，我汇报一批存在争议的矿产品采购。
The fictional gross weight is eight point four tonnes and the assumed moisture is three percent.
虚构毛重8.4吨，假设含水率3%。
The supplier reports thirty-two percent, while our laboratory reports thirty point eight percent.
供应商报告32%，我方实验室报告30.8%。
We have preserved both certificates and requested a joint sampling review.
我们保留了两份报告并要求联合复核取样。
The supplier requests full payment, but we recommend holding only the disputed balance.
供应商要求全额付款，但我们建议仅暂缓争议余额。
Finance will verify the beneficiary before any approved transfer.
财务将在任何获批转账前核验收款人。
Logistics has secured the truck and recorded the seals.
物流已妥善管控车辆并记录封签。
We will not backdate certificates or release cargo without mandatory documents.
我们不会倒签证明，也不会在缺少必需文件时放货。
After reviewing the evidence, we will issue a written decision and updated schedule.
证据复核后我们将发布书面决定和更新时间表。
Thank you. I am ready to answer questions.
谢谢，我愿意回答问题。
